body:
I just got a log from someone trying to play my game and in Godot 4.7 it no longer starting correctly, but it started correctly in Godot 4.6.3 for that person. So seems like they can no longer play when Vulkan is used? Which seems like a pretty major regression from 4.6.x to 4.7.

Here's the error:

